review_evidence: README identifies the project as Lean translations of the Ninety-Nine Haskell/Lisp Problems, with answers maintained in Lean source and exercises generated from them.
The hydrated source contains 51 Lean files and 103 proposition declarations.
Problem solutions, examples, and proposition-level checks are substantive pedagogical formal content and are retained by policy.
summary: Retain Lean 99 as a checked pedagogical problem-and-solution corpus with formal examples and propositions.
